answer.B1_import_boundary: One new scripts module, stdlib plus the existing photo_precore_bridge load(photo_semantic_witnesses) for exact neutral validators. Import-time module loading is the existing explicit neutral loader; resolution functions do no filesystem/network/runtime/candidate reads. Do not import photo_semantic_evidence, corpus, generator, guard evaluator or another consumer into this pure module.
answer.B2_central_owner: Existing photo_semantic_evidence.py remains the sole source/proof/selected-closure and guard coordinator. It creates one fresh normalized projection for B1. No second candidate/source parser or guard implementation in B1.
answer.activation_boundary: B1 is intentionally an unconnected, independently testable dependency until B2 is separately approved. Shipping B1 does NOT make mapv4/requestv2/guardv3 accepted or any scope source eligible. B2 must replace the existing duplicate expansion loops with B1 delegation; merely adding an unused utility beside them is not completion.

Walks actual selected source closure and independently resolves each source then rebuilds actual assignment keys and receiverSET.
Resolves maps again and separately expands each E target plus source-local receivers into property triples.
A separate point target remapping adapter exists. It must not remap already expanded actual addresses or substitute only a first scope member.
Own per-CID resolution cache and point scalar lookup; future quantified rules must consume B1 binding members instead of traversing/expanding scopes separately.

Node identity preserves exact CID/RID/meaning/qualification/projection digests. A self-hashed forged projection is not an admission certificate: B1 verifies transport/deterministic addressing; B2 verifies its actual source origin.

roots and selected_children are the actually chosen independent sources and required/explicitly selected optional edges only. B1 verifies this explicit node graph is closed, cycle-free, within existing depth8/edge8, with no unused nodes or missing children. It does not discover children or choose a branch.

Shared CID requires same RID/source/proof/projection/binding/child signature; conflicting RID/mapping rejects. Do not relax current single actual RID per CID in one composed selection. Identical shared nodes may share one calculation but every incoming edge/provenance remains recorded.

guard_only_targets is an explicitly normalized list created ONLY from B2 validated own common/branch source guards. B1 checks binding coverage equals fact targets/receivers plus this list. B2 retains sealed CID/frame ownership and rejects sibling/anonymous/optional child target injection. B1 does not authenticate a guard merely because this list names it.
exact_frozen_context: Recompute core canonical_sha256 from core excluding canonical_sha256/core_id, with existing exact canonical JSON convention. Do not accept a supplied graph or scopes table separate from this core.

Use existing neutral witnesses.read on exact core semantic_assertions/request_binding active spans/baseline/intent_lock. This revalidates StageA full input hashes/provenance/member presence/subject lock. owner_graph_sha256=digest(frozen.graph).

For scope opt-in: member_scopes_sha256=digest(frozen.member_scopes) in exact StageA row order; scope_sha256=digest(the exact StageA scope record including assertion_id/scope_id/source_span_ids/inventory). Each selected scope hash must match one exact record. No caller-provided members/subsets.

Point-only old contracts must remain valid without a new input_inventory or member_scopes key. Complete host input inventory is mandatory when a scope is actually used, as in StageA; it is not newly required for old fixed/selected point maps.

binding_normal_form.payload: Exact existing neutral core role resolves to its explicitly bound actual owner. Preserve current absence-of-presence requirement for fixed-role old maps; no new anatomy or kind inference.
Exact caller owner_id already in frozen graph and one independent atomic subject/entity.presence/v1 present fact; preserve raw actual ID and separately store explicit canonical ID.

Exact independently frozen scope ID/hash; use all members in stored order, validate canonical duplicates and presence via StageA again. Each_member and all_members tags are required, with no automatic point-to-scope conversion.

Preserve existing native-introduced:<meaning>:<RID>:<target> derivation and exact introduced_by add_entity fact. No source role already occupied in core. It is never eligible as an existing scope member or frozen guard endpoint; scope binding never introduces/removes members.

expansion_rules: Copy no source semantic values, modes or guards from words/tags/category. Input facts are already manually authored and source-qualified by B2; B1 only substitutes explicit actual addresses.

A point fact target yields one fact. A scope target yields one fact for EVERY stored actual member in stored order; no zip, first member, deduced descendant, partial list or predicate filter. Keep mode/requires/value/type/operation exactly and retain original CID/RID/factID/source target plus member provenance.

For an E receiver source target: point contributes that exact actual owner; scope contributes ALL actual members. Receiver expansion affects permission scope and canonical receiverSET only; it never copies the target assignment onto receivers. Store literal source receiver order and each expansion provenance even when canonical equality collapses repeated receiver aliases.

A collective style/layout E belongs to its separately genuine existing point wearer/scene/image, with all scope receivers. Uniform each-member E is a different explicitly authored source meaning; the resolver cannot turn a collective relationship into identical per-member coordinates or assign a fake ensemble/event owner.

P old/E new are not compared as competing E. Preserve each expanded prerequisite/preservation fact and exact actual owner for the B2 frozen matcher, with no parent/part fallback. All members must independently satisfy the relevant P/guard; one matching member cannot witness the rest.

A scope existing-only target cannot own add_entity/remove_entity. No count is derived from len(members), no new hands/people/items, no implicit exact-two interpretation, no reinterpretation of body.parts list equality as subset. Other manually authored assignments retain source semantics and still need B2 source review.

nodes: source identity and exact binding table tagged point/scope
raw and canonical actual owner IDs; scope/assertion/hash/member provenance; independent presence IDs
expanded facts retaining original source/CID/RID/factID/mode/typed value/requires/operation/literal receiver provenance

ledger_and_caps: E key is (dimension, actual canonical target, property), with exact type/value/operation and actual canonical receiverSET. Check within-node and across the entire explicitly supplied selected closure. Source-local E consistency is still independently enforced by B2 before projection; never loosen it.
Explicit equivalent is identity; part_of remains a distinct actual owner. Keep current introduced synthetic addresses unchanged; never canonicalize them into an existing graph owner.

Do not add a new64-total-node limit: existing64 limits owner-selection entries, not every fixed-role source in a selected dependency closure. Existing source facts4096/units2048/RIDs32, selection entries64, bindings/node32, depth8/edge8 and core64rows/32owners remain. Scope count8/member32/inventory65536UTF8bytes remain StageA.

At most32 expansions per source fact; existing generic4096facts gives a finite per-node upperbound131072 expanded fact records. Stream deterministic accumulation if needed, but never truncate or silently deduplicate provenance. Any smaller operational limit needs root approval and explicit rejection.
no_authority_flags: B1 has no allowed/qualified/native_admitted field, no guard pass or permission pass, no pack/publication/runtime receipt output. It returns deterministic address resolution or a structural error.
A property footprint is necessary for existing locks but does not grant permission. Even equal-value E on a frozen property still fails B2 lock evaluation; unknown overlap denies.
